title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible countries worldwide
deadline: Varies by country (typically April - October annually)
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Airfare, Living Stipend, Health Insurance)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States.

title: Google Software Engineering Internship 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Experience in Software Development and coding in C++, Java, Python, or Go
description: Offers students the opportunity to work on real-world projects alongside Google engineers and impact millions of users.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to candidates globally with reliable high-speed internet access
qualification: 1+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks like Vue.js or React
description: Contribute to building and improving GitLab's user-facing web applications in a fully asynchronous, remote environment.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent university graduates or early career professionals with 0-2 years of experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or related technical/quantitative discipline
description: Drive product strategy, design features, and work closely with cross-functional engineering teams across Microsoft products.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and self-learners worldwide
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university
salary: $100,000 Grand Prize + Mentorship with Microsoft CEO
qualification: Active student status; capability to build software solutions using Microsoft Azure
description: A global technology competition encouraging student innovators to build tech solutions addressing social, environmental, or commercial challenges.
